伊娃的生活方式(Eva's Way of Living): 一篇关于校园生活的B1记叙文:伊娃的经历、感受与成长。
Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Eva thanked Sam for the honest advice. Eva is saving money to buy a ticket to Tokyo. The vice-chancellor praised the volunteers.

Eva has practiced basketball for three years and won a prize last term. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. The reading room has become an important part of daily life. The thick shag rug feels wonderful under bare feet.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. People around Eva often share different ideas about the school gate. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Also, she gazed wistfully at photos of her childhood home.

The experience taught Eva more than any book could. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Eva usually spends the weekend reading at the library. In fact, baking soda can neutralise the acid in the tomato sauce.
Sam always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Eva wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Little by little, things began to change.
